description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1944/64 of 12.12.2015 Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620278
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land title records, including servitude rights, shared possession rights, ownership details, and encumbrances for various parcels of land across different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property ownership matters.
